grain: One row per claim on the claims register (stg.claims), with its payment history rolled up to the reporting date (as_of); claims with no payments yet are kept too.

columns.name: total_paid

columns.name: indemnity_amt
columns.description: Sum of INDEMNITY-type amounts (type matched ignoring case). NULL if the claim has no payments, or if any payment amount was missing, because '+' carries missing values through.

columns.name: first_payment_date
columns.description: payment_date of the claim's first payment in keyed order (_row_seq), not necessarily the earliest date.

columns.name: last_payment_date
columns.description: payment_date of the claim's last payment in keyed order (_row_seq), not necessarily the latest date.

columns.name: recovery_flag

columns.name: has_payment

columns.name: gross_paid
